description: This file implements Android Debug Bridge (ADB) backend functionality, including device management, command execution, and socket communication, for the Playwright project.

classes.name: AdbBackend
classes.description: Main class providing methods to list Android devices via ADB.

classes.name: AdbDevice
classes.description: Represents an individual Android device, allowing command execution and socket connection.

classes.name: BufferedSocketWrapper
classes.description: Wraps a net.Socket to handle ADB protocol messaging, buffering, and socket mode.

methods.name: runCommand
methods.description: Executes an ADB command over a socket, handling protocol messaging and response parsing.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an ADB connection for a command, returning a socket wrapper.
